amendments.body: `crates/tank_core/src/budget_helpers.rs:177-188` only emits `TANK_BUDGET_DEBUG` output after `engine.step_hours(hours)` succeeds. If stepping fails after one or more successful ticks, those completed ticks have already been recorded in the ledger (`crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:254-255`), but `step_and_inspect` returns early and prints nothing. That makes the new debug hook useless in the exact failure mode it is supposed to help diagnose. Print newly recorded ticks on the error path too, or otherwise surface the partial inspection data before returning the error.
amendments.rationale: This is a real robustness gap in the new debug workflow: failures currently suppress the budget summaries that developers need for diagnosis.

amendments.body: `crates/tank_core/tests/water_change_mass_balance.rs:16-30` now calls `systems::water_change::apply_water_change` directly instead of queueing `PlayerAction::WaterChangePercent` and stepping the engine. That bypasses the public integration path in `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:435-460`, so this test no longer covers queue draining, action processing order, source-profile lookup through the engine, or any invariant/budget interaction attached to the real action. Keep the fixture isolated from atmospheric exchange if needed, but preserve at least one assertion that exercises `engine.apply_action(...); engine.step_hours(1)`.
amendments.rationale: The change weakens coverage of the player-visible water-change path and can let regressions in action handling slip through while the test still passes.

amendments.body: The new helper API is still only exercised from the dedicated synthetic file `crates/tank_core/tests/budget_helpers.rs:136-154`; the existing shrimp conservation tests in `crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_feeding_pathway.rs:206-234` continue to hand-roll `total_nitrogen()` / `total_carbon()` before-after checks even though this bead introduced `step_and_inspect` plus one-line assertions. That leaves the acceptance criterion about retrofitting an existing test unmet and misses an integration point showing future authors how to use the helper in a real scenario test. Convert one of those existing conservation tests to `step_and_inspect` + `assert_n_conserved` / `assert_c_conserved`.
amendments.rationale: Without a real scenario retrofit, the API is only validated in purpose-built helper tests, which increases the risk that it drifts from actual test-author workflows.

payload.summary: Reviewed the diff plus the budget helper and engine code paths. I found three substantive issues: debug output is dropped on failed inspections, the updated water-change regression test no longer exercises the public action path, and the new helper API still is not wired into an existing scenario test despite that being part of the bead’s acceptance criteria.
